identity.medication-identity-incomplete: identity incomplete, missing ingredient or route

rule.source-ref-equality: Both records cite the same source record.
rule.medication-identity-match: Both medications have the same ingredients and route.
rule.medication-identity-mismatch: The medications differ in their ingredients or route.
rule.medication-identity-incomplete: One side lacks an ingredient or a route, so nothing can match it.
rule.deterministic-code-exact: Both records carry the same clinical code.
rule.deterministic-code-hierarchical: Their codes differ, but one is a broader form of the other.
rule.concept-identity-match: Both records resolve to the same clinical concept.
rule.deterministic-code-mismatch: They carry different codes in the same code system.

nlp-normalization-match.reject: Their wording still differed once normalized.

embedding-similarity.merge: Their descriptions are close in meaning.
embedding-similarity.reject: Their descriptions are far apart in meaning.

llm-adjudication.merge: A language model read both and judged them the same thing.
llm-adjudication.reject: A language model read both and judged them different things.
